Enjoy guaranteed patient flow, superb billing potential and a vibrant, multicultural work environment, in a modern, well-established practice just 15 minutes from the Adelaide CBD.   

  What we offer  

 
	 Strong earning potential – mixed billing practice with GPs achieving $350+ per hour. 70% of billings. 
	 We’re a busy, well-established practice with a large patient base in an underserviced and growing community, so you can be guaranteed a strong patient flow from day one. 
	 Spacious 375 sqm practice with 10 GP consult rooms, 2 nurse rooms, pathology and a 2-bed treatment room. 
	 Quality CDM & clinical nursing support = reduced workload + greater income (standard service fee on nurse billings). 
	 Enjoy work-life balance and full flexibility over your hours. 
	 Modern, well-equipped, fully computerised practice (Best Practice) with responsive IT support from Cyber Squad. 
	 Collegiate atmosphere, with a professional, yet relaxed vibe, and respectful patients. 
	 Enjoy the autonomy to practise your way. We advocate quality healthcare and 15-minute appointments as standard, so there’s no pressure to practise fast medicine. 
	 Be part of a growing network of clinics and enjoy access to regular GP networking and professional development events.

result.description:
MedicalJobsAustralia.com     Monash Health exists to reimagine care, so that people can live their best lives. 






We provide safe and equitable care, for every stage of life, delivered with world-leading expertise and over 175 years of experience. 






As a leading academic health service, we're committed to providing tomorrow's care today by integrating research, teaching and training into everyday practice. 






Our team of 24,000 people are full hearted, open minded and all in. Together, we provide more than 250 integrated services for every stage of life at over 50 locations and in the community across south-east Melbourne, Victoria, serving 1.2 million residents in the South Metro Local Health Service Network. 


Are you currently part of the team at Monash Health? Use your network login to access the Monash Health Careers portal and discover all the job opportunities open to you, to support growing your career within the organisation.




To see first-hand what our colleagues think about working here, take a look at the following short videos monashhealth.org-careers.









We're seeking a Compliance Officer to support statutory obligations under the Mental Health and Wellbeing Act 2022 across our Mental Health Program.












About the Role






In this role, you'll provide specialist advice, coordinate Mental Health Tribunal processes, monitor restrictive practices, and support compliance audits and reporting. You'll work closely with clinical teams, Tribunal Officers, leadership groups and external agencies to ensure consistent, rights-based practice.









Support compliance with the Mental Health and Wellbeing Act 2022












Coordinate and quality-check Mental Health Tribunal documentation












Monitor and report on restrictive practices across clinical settings












Contribute to audits, data reviews and improvement initiatives












Identify emerging compliance risks and escalate appropriately












Collaborate with Informatics and BI teams to strengthen data systems












Provide guidance to Tribunal and Audit Officers















About You






You bring strong judgement, attention to detail and a commitment to safe, ethical mental health care. You have experience in compliance, governance, legal or regulatory roles, ideally within healthcare or the public sector. You're confident analysing data, interpreting legislation and supporting multidisciplinary teams.












Qualifications: 









Tertiary qualification in health, law, social sciences, public administration, business, compliance or similar; or equivalent experience












Knowledge of the Mental Health and Wellbeing Act 2022 (or ability to rapidly acquire it)












Experience with statutory, tribunal or regulatory processes is highly valued















Why Monash Health:









Supportive, values-driven team












Opportunities for professional development












Contribute to meaningful improvements in mental health care















If you're passionate about promoting, high-quality mental health practice, we'd love to hear from you.




For a confidential discussion and to explore this opportunity further, please reach out to Eleanor Donaghy - Manager of Legal Compliance Monitoring and Reporting on 0409 057 371.


Position Description can be found here





Our Culture and Values 






At Monash Health, our people are at the heart of everything we do. Our culture is inclusive, supportive and future-focused, underpinned by clear values and a commitment to continuous improvement. 






Our teams play a critical role in bringing our new strategy to life, challenging traditional approaches, embracing innovation, and ensuring every appointment reflects our commitment to equity, transparency and excellence. 






You'll be encouraged to share ideas, contribute to improvement initiatives, and grow alongside experienced professionals who are passionate about what they do. 






We are Full Hearted, Open Minded and All In, enabling excellent service delivery and a positive candidate and employee experience every time. 






We recognise the value of equal employment opportunity. We are committed to patient safety, promoting fairness, equity and diversity in the workplace and to Child Safe Standards. 





How to Apply


Applications are accepted via the Monash Health online EHub system. For information including how to apply and probity check requirements, please click here for the 'Application Guide'


Applications will be screened upon receipt and selection activity may commence prior to the closing date. 


Applications close July 14th, 2026.    Click here to Apply now →
